Scenario Title: Complete full onboarding walkthrough to My Stash
Test Steps & Actions: User menekan tombol "Next" di setiap slide (Create Boxes, Scan & Share, Search Everything) lalu menekan "Got it!".
Expected Result: Dialihkan ke dashboard "My Stash".

Scenario Title: Skip onboarding from the initial welcome screen
Test Steps & Actions: User langsung menekan tombol "Skip" pada slide selamat datang pertama.
Expected Result: Langsung dialihkan ke dashboard "My Stash".

Scenario Title: Skip onboarding midway from step two
Test Steps & Actions: User menekan "Next" 1 kali ke slide kedua ("Create Boxes"), lalu menekan tombol "Skip".
Expected Result: Dialihkan ke dashboard "My Stash".

Scenario Title: Verify onboarding step headers correspond to expected feature guides
Test Steps & Actions: Memvalidasi teks judul pada setiap slide onboarding secara berurutan: "Create Boxes", "Scan & Share", dan "Search Everything".

Scenario Title: Create a new box with all fields populated
Test Steps & Actions: Input nama "Kitchenware", deskripsi "Fragile plates", warna "Blue", dan lokasi "Kitchen Cupboard A".
Expected Result: Kotak muncul di daftar My Stash.

Scenario Title: Create a new box with only mandatory name field
Test Steps & Actions: Input nama "Garage Tools" dan kosongkan field opsional.
Expected Result: Kotak berhasil dibuat dan muncul di My Stash.

Scenario Title: View box detail and verify action buttons
Test Steps & Actions: Buka detail kotak "Kitchenware".
Expected Result: Tombol "Add new item" dan "Show QR code" tampil aktif.

Scenario Title: Add a box to favorites
Test Steps & Actions: Buka menu aksi kotak, tap "Add to favorites".
Expected Result: Menu berubah menjadi "Remove from favorites".

Scenario Title: Remove a box from favorites
Test Steps & Actions: Buka menu aksi kotak favorit, tap "Remove from favorites".
Expected Result: Menu kembali menjadi "Add to favorites".

Scenario Title: Edit existing box details and save changes successfully
Test Steps & Actions: Buka edit box, perbarui nama ke "Kitchenware Updated" dan lokasi "Basement B", lalu simpan.
Expected Result: Judul kotak terupdate seketika.

Scenario Title: Fail to save box edits when box name is cleared
Test Steps & Actions: Buka edit box, kosongkan field nama, tap "Save Changes".
Expected Result: Muncul dialog validasi "Name required" / "Please enter a name" dan tetap di form.

Scenario Title: Cancel box editing and verify original details remain unchanged
Test Steps & Actions: Ubah nama dan lokasi di form edit, lalu tekan tombol "Cancel".
Expected Result: Nama asli "Kitchenware Updated" tetap terjaga tanpa berubah.

Scenario Title: Cancel box deletion and verify box is preserved in stash
Test Steps & Actions: Buka dialog konfirmasi hapus kotak ("Delete Box?"), tap "CANCEL".
Expected Result: Modal tertutup dan kotak tetap ada di detail screen.

Scenario Title: Delete a box permanently and verify removal from stash dashboard
Test Steps & Actions: Buka dialog hapus, tap "DELETE".
Expected Result: Dialihkan ke My Stash dan kotak "Kitchenware Updated" hilang permanen dari daftar.

Scenario Title: Allow creation of duplicate box names and update total box counter
Test Steps & Actions: Buat kotak kedua dengan nama sama ("Garage Tools").
Expected Result: Dua kotak mandiri berhasil terbuat dan counter bertambah.

Scenario Title: Search for an existing box by name
Test Steps & Actions: Ketik query "Garage Tools" di input search.
Expected Result: Item "Garage Tools" tampil di hasil pencarian.

Scenario Title: Clear search query and restore full box list
Test Steps & Actions: Tap tombol "Clear search" (`~Clear search`).
Expected Result: Input search bersih dan seluruh daftar kotak kembali tampil.

Scenario Title: Search box with case-insensitive query
Test Steps & Actions: Ketik query huruf kecil "garage tools".
Expected Result: Tetap menemukan kotak "Garage Tools".

Scenario Title: Search box using partial substring matching
Test Steps & Actions: Ketik potongan kata "Tools".
Expected Result: Kotak "Garage Tools" tetap berhasil ditemukan.

Scenario Title: Search box with leading and trailing whitespace query
Test Steps & Actions: Ketik query dengan spasi di awal dan akhir (`"  Garage Tools  "`).
Expected Result: Spasi otomatis di-trim dan hasil pencarian valid.

Scenario Title: Search for a box by the name of an item stored inside it
Test Steps & Actions: Ketik nama item anak ("Ceramic Mug").
Expected Result: Kontainer kotak induk yang menyimpan item tersebut ditampilkan.

Scenario Title: Fail to create box when mandatory box name is empty
Test Steps & Actions: Buka form New Box tanpa mengisi nama, langsung tap "Create box".
Expected Result: Muncul validasi popup dan user tetap di form.

Scenario Title: Search with non-existent keyword shows empty results state
Test Steps & Actions: Cari keyword fiktif "xyz_nonexistent_item_999".
Expected Result: Menampilkan teks "No results" dan "No items match your search.".

Scenario Title: Create a box with special characters and numerical identifiers
Test Steps & Actions: Input nama `"Box #101 [Fragile] & 100% Cotton"`.
Expected Result: Karakter simbol tersimpan aman di database dan tampil di daftar.

Scenario Title: Search box with special regex characters without application crash
Test Steps & Actions: Cari query simbol regex (`"*?+[]%_'"`).
Expected Result: Pencarian dieksekusi secara aman tanpa app crash atau unhandled syntax error.

Scenario Title: Fail to create box when name contains only whitespace
Test Steps & Actions: Input nama hanya spasi `"     "`, tap Create Box.
Expected Result: Ditolak dan user tetap berada di form New Box.

Scenario Title: Create a box with minimum boundary single-character name
Test Steps & Actions: Input nama 1 karakter `"B"`, tap Create Box.
Expected Result: Kotak "B" berhasil tersimpan dan tampil di My Stash.

Scenario Title: Create a box with script injection tags and verify literal text rendering
Test Steps & Actions: Input nama `"<script>alert(1)</script> Safe Box"`.
Expected Result: Teks dirender sebagai string biasa (*literal*) tanpa eksekusi kode.

Scenario Title: Cancel box creation midway and verify draft is not saved to stash
Test Steps & Actions: Ketik nama "Abandoned Draft Box" lalu tap tombol Go back/Kembali.
Expected Result: Kembali ke My Stash dan kotak draft tidak tersimpan.

Scenario Title: Preserve dashboard state when application is minimized to background
Test Steps & Actions: Minimize aplikasi ke background selama 2 detik lalu buka kembali.
Expected Result: Dashboard My Stash tetap aktif dan stabil tanpa crash.

Scenario Title: Add a new item with photo, title, description, and adjusted quantity
Test Steps & Actions: Ambil foto simulasi kamera, isi judul "Ceramic Mug", deskripsi "White porcelain", tambah kuantitas jadi 2, lalu simpan.
Expected Result: Item tersimpan di dalam kotak.

Scenario Title: Add an item with mandatory title only and default quantity
Test Steps & Actions: Ambil foto, isi judul "Vintage Spoon", kosongkan deskripsi dengan kuantitas default 1.
Expected Result: Item berhasil tersimpan.

Scenario Title: Adjust item quantity using increment and decrement controls
Test Steps & Actions: Tap tombol tambah kuantitas 2 kali (menjadi 3), lalu tap tombol kurangi 1 kali (menjadi 2).
Expected Result: Kuantitas tercatat 2.

Scenario Title: Add an item with minimum boundary single-character title
Test Steps & Actions: Ambil foto, input judul 1 karakter ("A"), lalu simpan.
Expected Result: Item "A" berhasil tersimpan.

Scenario Title: Fail to save item when mandatory title is empty
Test Steps & Actions: Ambil foto, biarkan judul kosong, tap "Save Item".
Expected Result: Validasi menolak dan user tetap di layar "Add Item Details".

Scenario Title: Fail to save item when title contains only whitespace
Test Steps & Actions: Ambil foto, isi judul hanya spasi `"   "`, tap "Save Item".
Expected Result: Validasi menolak dan user tetap di layar form.

Scenario Title: Cancel item creation and discard captured photo
Test Steps & Actions: Ambil foto, lalu tekan tombol "Cancel".
Expected Result: Kembali ke detail box dan item serta foto dibatalkan.

Scenario Title: Add an item with special characters, punctuation, and emojis
Test Steps & Actions: Input judul `"USB-C Cable (60W) #FastCharge ⚡️"`.
Expected Result: Karakter Unicode emoji dan simbol tersimpan sempurna di SQLite.

Scenario Title: Add an item with maximum length boundary title and long description
Test Steps & Actions: Input judul sangat panjang 150 karakter dan deskripsi 200 karakter.
Expected Result: Item tersimpan tanpa pemotongan teks yang merusak layout.

Scenario Title: Add an item with script injection tags and verify literal text rendering
Test Steps & Actions: Input judul `"<script>alert('XSS')</script> Safe Title"`.
Expected Result: Teks dirender sebagai plain string tanpa eksekusi script.

Scenario Title: Remove an attached photo before saving item
Test Steps & Actions: Ambil foto, lalu tap tombol "Remove photo" sebelum menyimpan item.
Expected Result: Foto terhapus dari preview.

Scenario Title: Trigger QR code scanner from dashboard
Test Steps & Actions: Tap tombol "Scan" (`~Scan`) di dashboard My Stash.
Expected Result: Layar viewfinder scanner kamera atau prompt izin kamera terbuka.

Scenario Title: Verify camera permission requirement message when scanner is launched
Test Steps & Actions: Izin kamera dicabut (`revoke android.permission.CAMERA`), buka scanner.
Expected Result: Menampilkan tombol "Grant camera permission" dan pesan edukasi izin.

Scenario Title: Return safely to My Stash after opening scanner
Test Steps & Actions: Buka scanner, lalu tekan tombol kembali (Back hardware / nav).
Expected Result: Pengguna kembali aman ke dashboard "My Stash" tanpa freeze.

Scenario Title: Switch application language to Bahasa Indonesia
Test Steps & Actions: Buka Settings, pilih opsi bahasa "Bahasa Indonesia".
Expected Result: Radio button Bahasa Indonesia terpilih, header berubah menjadi "Pengaturan", dan dashboard menjadi "Simpananku".

Scenario Title: Switch application language back to English
Test Steps & Actions: Buka Settings, pilih opsi bahasa "English".
Expected Result: Radio button English terpilih, header kembali "Settings", dan dashboard kembali "My Stash".

Scenario Title: Navigate to About Kotakin screen and verify app version
Test Steps & Actions: Buka Settings, tap tombol "About Kotakin", verifikasi teks "Version". Lalu tap "Go back".
Expected Result: Versi aplikasi tampil dan berhasil kembali ke Settings.

Scenario Title: Navigate back to My Stash from Settings screen
Test Steps & Actions: Buka Settings, tap tombol "Go back" (`~Go back` / `~Kembali`).
Expected Result: Pengguna kembali ke dashboard utama My Stash.

Scenario Title: Verify Backup and Restore action buttons are accessible
Test Steps & Actions: Buka Settings, periksa tombol aksi cadangan lokal.
Expected Result: Tombol "Create zip backup" dan "Restore from zip backup" tampil aktif.
